prompt_contract: For each constraint, fill params using exactly these type-specific keys: budget={max_total_cost_cny:number}; deadline={max_duration_hours:number}; privacy={forbidden_recipients:string[],protected_data_classes:string[]}; tool_auth={approval_role:string,required_role:string}; order={before_role:string,after_role:string}, where before_role is the earlier role and after_role is the later role. Use values supported by the query, preserving numeric values and units. Use severity high for budget, deadline, and privacy; medium for tool_auth and order. scope must contain matching role:<name> values from Available role vocabulary: budget includes cost-incurring roles; deadline includes the terminal task role; privacy includes roles sending protected data to a forbidden recipient; tool_auth includes required_role; order includes both before_role and after_role. evidence_span must be a verbatim query span. state=explicit when directly stated, implicit when only conveyed by context, and none only when the query contains no constraint.
